@@U00158@@
I have no friend of my youth to pass it on to,
nor any reason now for rhyming.
This is a drink that soon intoxicates,
a drink I prepared myself and now
pour its dark liquid into your brimming cup.
I pledge it now, with all my heart,
to the new day.

@@U00159@@
(As he puts the goblet to his lips, church bells and a choir are heard.)

@@U00161@@
Christ is ascended!
Hail the glad token,
True was it spoken,
Sin’s fetters are broken,
Man's bondage is ended!

@@U00163@@
What deep resonance, what clear, shining note
has such power to drag this chalice from my lips?
Muted bells announce the Easter festival,
and choirs sing their song of consolation
first sung by angels at that darkened tomb—
proclamation of a new faith, a new covenant.

@@U00165@@
With myrrh and with aloes
We balmed and we bathed Him,
Loyally, lovingly,
Tenderly swathed Him;
With cerecloth and band
For the grave we arrayed Him;
But, oh, He is gone
From the place where we laid Him!

@@U00167@@
Christ is ascended!
The love that possessed Him,
The pangs that oppressed Him,
translation:
@@U00158@@
我没有年轻时的朋友可以将它传递给我，
现在也没有任何理由押韵。
这是一种很快就会陶醉的饮料，
我自己准备的饮料，现在
将其黑色液体倒入满溢的杯子中。
我现在全心全意地发誓
到新的一天。

@@U00159@@
（当他把高脚杯放到唇边时，教堂的钟声和唱诗班的声音响起。）

@@U00161@@
基督升天了！
向快乐的象征致敬，
确实是这样说的，
罪恶的枷锁被打破，
人类的束缚结束了！

@@U00163@@
多么深沉的共鸣，多么清晰、闪亮的音符
有这么大的力量能把这个圣杯从我嘴里拖下来吗？
柔和的钟声宣告了复活节的到来，
唱诗班唱着他们的安慰之歌
天使在那个黑暗的坟墓里首先唱出——
宣告新的信仰、新的圣约。

@@U00165@@
含有没药和芦荟
我们用香膏给他洗澡，
忠诚、充满爱心，
温柔地包裹着他；
带有蜡布和带子
我们为他铺好坟墓；
但是，哦，他走了
从我们安放他的地方！

@@U00167@@
基督升天了！
爱占据了他，
压迫他的痛苦，
